label: PINCER 3
statement: Patients aged 75 years and older who have been prescribed an ACE inhibitor or a loop diuretic long-term (see below) who have not had a computer-recorded check of their renal function and electrolytes in the previous 15 months: - More specifically, long-term prescribing implies a first prescription for an ACE inhibitor or a loop diuretic at least 15 months before the time of data collection and at least one prescription in the six months beforehand - The denominator for this outcome measure is patients aged 75 years and older who have been prescribed an ACE inhibitor or a loop diuretic long-term according to the above definition.
